subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 4: I want to be a doctor!
lesson: Unit 4 – Lesson 5: Culture (the yellow school bus)
outcomes: I can talk about the yellow school bus.
I can ask: How do you go to school?
I can read a bar graph about school transport.

tf.s: All school buses in the United States are yellow.
tf.why: Yes! School buses there are yellow.

tf.s: Cars don't stop for school buses in the United States.
Bus drivers take students to school in the morning.
tf.why: Right! And they take them home in the afternoon.

tf.s: Bus drivers take students home at night.
tf.why: They take students home in the afternoon.

tf.s: School buses in Oman are yellow too.
tf.why: Yes! Our school buses are yellow too.

tf.s: The tallest bar on a graph shows the most common transport.
tf.why: Well done! The tallest bar shows the most.

tf.s: The shortest bar shows the most students.
tf.why: The shortest bar shows the least.

tf.s: We say: I walk to school.
We say: I go to school by a car.
tf.why: No a after by: I go to school by car.

tf.s: A bus driver is a student on the bus.
tf.why: A bus driver drives the bus.

boxes.q: What colour are school buses in the United States?

boxes.why: The bus driver drives the bus.

boxes.q: What do cars do for school buses?
When do students go home on the school bus?
boxes.why: They go home in the afternoon.

boxes.q: Ask a friend about school transport.
o: How do you go to school?
boxes.why: We ask: How do you go to school?

boxes.q: Complete: I go to school ___ bus.
Complete: In our group, two students ___ to school.
What does a bar graph help us do?
boxes.why: A graph helps us compare numbers.

boxes.q: Which word means the opposite of most?

mcq.q: Where are all the school buses yellow?
mcq.why: The text is about school buses in the United States.

mcq.q: When do bus drivers take students to school?
mcq.why: They take students to school in the morning.

mcq.q: Which word is about school transport?
mcq.why: A school bus takes students to school.

mcq.q: What do we draw to show how our group goes to school?
mcq.why: We collect data and draw a bar graph.

mcq.q: Graph: car 4, bus 3, walk 2. Which is the most common?
Graph: car 4, bus 3, walk 2. Write a sentence.
o: In our group, four students go to school by car.
In our group, four students go to school by bus.
In our group, two students go to school by car.
In our group, four students walks to school.

mcq.q: True or False: Bus drivers drive the school buses.
mcq.why: Bus drivers drive the school buses.

mcq.q: Graph: bus 5, car 3, walk 1. Which is the least common?
Why do cars stop for school buses?
How are school buses in Oman like school buses in the United States?
mcq.why: In both places, school buses are yellow.
